scope: One bounded original-source qualification sample; no global conversion or publication claim.
acceptance: Refuse existing destination/report and path-traversing names.
Require 40 GiB free before source transfer, 10 GiB during it; cap transfer at expected size plus one and refuse checksum/size mismatch.
Verify original source size and producer MD5 before opening SQLite read-only; record independently computed SHA-256.
Require SQLite quick_check to return only ok; inspect ordinary tables, column types, PK/FK and row counts without loading extensions or executing source schema/view SQL.
Keep source bytes in ignored local storage. All conclusions about schema/row counts apply only to this tile until other tiles are independently inspected.
